source_evidence: For accepted orders the warehouse picks the parts, packs the order and books a carrier.
problem: The warehouse department is classified as an automated authority instead of a human department.
correction: Change Lane_warehouse laneMeta authority from "authority" to "sovereignty".

source_evidence:
The warehouse also does quality inspection and labelling for each order, but nobody could
say whether those happen before or after packing, or in which order relative to each other.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="pick-parts--quality-inspection" sourceRef="pick-parts" targetRef="quality-inspection" /><bpmn:sequenceFlow id="quality-inspection--pack-order" sourceRef="quality-inspection" targetRef="pack-order" />

problem: Quality inspection is fixed between picking and packing even though its position relative to packing is explicitly unknown.
correction: Remove the two flows through quality-inspection and their incoming/outgoing references, restore a direct pick-parts to pack-order flow, and leave quality-inspection unconnected with an associated note declaring its unknown order relative to packing and labelling.

map_evidence.quote: <bpmn:task id="send-payment-reminder" name="Send payment reminder"><bpmn:documentation>source: "The ERP sends a payment reminder after seven days."</bpmn:documentation>

problem: The map adds an ERP payment-reminder task and a seven-day claim supported by a fabricated source quotation.
correction: Remove send-payment-reminder, its lane reference and incident flows, and connect generate-and-send-invoice directly to accepted-order-fulfilled, updating incoming/outgoing references.
